head: ed57be76588012ea62e2d927f4165f3aec98fded
title: fix(messaging): DM reports always file; live reads and Home unread count (AUDIT-03-125)
body:
**Tier:** T3
**Why:** Safety and App Store 1.2 surface (DM abuse reports) plus two read-state fixes on the coach/client 1:1 thread. No auth, tenancy, money, credential or destructive-data change.
**T4 trigger scan:** none. No auth/RLS/tenancy change, no PII newly shown (the Home count is the signed-in client's own unread total from an existing route), no money, no credentials, no deletes.
**T3 trigger scan:** safety reporting path (report reason wire values, crisis line copy), cross-screen read state.
**Bounded T1:** copy and a badge on HomeHeaderActions.
**Canonical builder:** AUDIT-03-125 (agent 125, Claude Opus 5.5).
**Acceptance evidence:** jest specs below fail on main and pass here; works against the CURRENT production backend (only reasons the deployed DTO accepts are sent; `/messages/unread-count` and `/coach/clients/:id/messages/read` already exist). No backend change, no flag, no dependency, no lockfile.

### Fixes
- **B1 (safety / App Store 1.2):** A client or coach who reports a message as "Hate speech", "Violence or threats" or "Misinformation" was told "Sending your report could not be confirmed. Check your connection" and the report was never filed, because the backend accepts only `spam | harassment | sexual | self_harm | other` (backend `src/messages-safety/dto/report-message.dto.ts`). Now every category is sent as an accepted reason (`hate_speech`, `violence` -> `harassment`; `misinformation` -> `other`) with the picked category first in `details`, so the reviewer still sees it. The sheet also gains "Self-harm or suicide" (backend and community sheet already have it) and shows the owner-approved 911 / 988 line for self-harm and violence.
- **U1:** A coach chatting live saw the client's new message appear, but it stayed unread (Messages badge kept counting it, the client never saw "Read") until the coach left and reopened the thread. The coach-channel ping and the 60 s backstop now refetch and mark read up to the newest client message, like the client side already does.
- **U2:** A client on Home had no sign the coach replied: "Message <coach>" now carries the unread coach-message count (badge + accessibility label), refreshed on Home focus, foreground and every 30 s.

### Tests
- `src/api/__tests__/messagesApi.test.ts`: every sheet category is sent as a backend-accepted reason; folded categories keep their label in details; self-harm is offered and sent verbatim. (The old test asserted the broken values and "not self_harm".)
- `src/components/messaging/__tests__/ReportMessageSheet.test.tsx`: Self-harm option; 911 / 988 line shown for self-harm and violence only.
- `src/screens/coach/__tests__/ClientMessagesScreenV2.test.tsx`: a client message arriving on the coach channel is marked read up to that message.
- `src/components/home/__tests__/HomeHeaderActions.test.tsx`: "Message Bradley, 2 unread".
- `HomeScreen.macroMode.test.tsx`: navigation mock gains `useFocusEffect`.

Size: about 215 changed lines. Overlap with open PRs: none (m#402-m#415 touch none of these files).
